recentItems.title: CNN goes inside rescue operations in worst-hit area of Nepal
recentItems.description: Six days after devastating floods struck the Nepal-China border, CNN’s Anderson Cooper speaks with rescuers on the front lines as they work to reach hundreds of hydropower workers who are unaccounted for.

recentItems.title: Nepal's first female helicopter captain speaks to CNN
recentItems.description: Captain Priya Adhikari, Nepal’s first female helicopter captain, has flown nearly 100 missions in just days – navigating treacherous valleys and unstable ground, to bring survivors to safety and dignity to the dead.

recentItems.title: Teen charged in deadly San Diego mosque shooting
recentItems.description: A North Carolina teenager has been indicted on murder charges in connection with the deadly mass shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego earlier this year. Her attorney told CNN she is "innocent of all these charges". CNN's Dianne Gallagher reports.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Mass Burial in Nepal for unidentified flood victims
recentItems.description: Authorities are burying hundreds of unidentified victims after catastrophic flooding overwhelmed morgues and left families unable to reach loved ones. CNN’s Hanako Montgomery reports.

recentItems.title: Retired general warns US military 'weaker' under Hegseth than pre-9/11
recentItems.description: A retired top Army General warns that the Secretary of Defense is a "clear and present danger" to national security, pointing to the purge of over 20 senior officers and dozens of blocked general promotions. Retired Major General Randy Manner tells Erin Burnett the military command structure is dangerously hollowed out and "weaker" than it was prior to 9/11, saying the Secretary "has got to go" because his actions are putting service members in harm's way.

recentItems.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns amid Hegseth feud
recentItems.description:
Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has submitted his resignation to President Donald Trump, multiple sources familiar with the matter told CNN.

One source said the decision was unsurprising given tension between Driscoll and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.

An Army official said Driscoll “spoke to the president about the current state of the Army and submitted his resignation.”
